commands.review_summary:
The PR adds an optional total request timeout to shared web-media loading and applies a 15-minute deadline to Tlon media download and URL-backed image upload fetches.

PR surface: Source +15, Tests +52. Total +67 across 6 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current source provides a high-confidence path: an endpoint can accept the connection and withhold headers indefinitely because `readIdleTimeoutMs` only governs response-body chunk reads and these callers provide no request deadline.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The contributor needs to correct the timeout semantics and provide real behavior proof; an automated repair lane cannot produce evidence from the contributor's runtime setup.

target.title: fix(web-media): add timeoutMs option to WebMediaOptions for remote fetches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`loadWebMedia` / `loadWebMediaRaw` accepted `readIdleTimeoutMs` (idle timeout between data chunks) but had no overall request timeout for remote HTTP fetches. A server that accepts the connection then never sends headers — or withholds response data — held the download open indefinitely. The Tlon download/upload fetch paths had the same gap: only a body-idle guard, no total deadline.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is the **canonical** PR for the shared `WebMediaOptions.timeoutMs` seam plus the Tlon caller wiring. It exposes the existing `readRemoteMediaBuffer` / `fetchWithSsrFGuard` `timeoutMs` (an `AbortSignal`-backed total request lifetime) through `loadWebMediaInternal`, and applies it at the two Tlon remote-fetch call sites.

The total deadline is `15 * 60_000` (15 min), **aligning with the canonical bounded-media ceiling** established by the merged node-camera fix (#103266, `src/cli/nodes-camera.ts:20`). A shorter cap was flagged by ClawSweeper as a P1 compatibility risk because `timeoutMs` stays active through complete body consumption and would newly fail slow-but-progressing transfers; 15 min matches the accepted precedent while `readIdleTimeoutMs` (30 s for Tlon) continues to bound body-idle stalls on a tighter schedule.

Sibling caller PRs (telegram #103020, qqbot #103018, agent-tools #103209) apply the same invariant at distinct caller boundaries; the Tlon-only #103199 is closed as a subset of this PR.

## User Impact

- Remote media fetches that previously hung forever on a never-responding endpoint now abort after the total deadline and reach their established fallback: `downloadMedia` → `null`, `uploadImageFromUrl` → original URL.
- Slow-but-progressing transfers are unaffected: they remain bounded by `readIdleTimeoutMs`, and 15 min is the accepted ceiling for legitimate large transfers.
- Callers of `loadWebMedia`/`loadWebMediaRaw` can now opt into `timeoutMs` to cap total request duration.

## Evidence

**Source:**
- `src/media/web-media.ts`: added `timeoutMs?: number` to `WebMediaOptions`; forwarded through `loadWebMediaInternal` into the `readRemoteMediaBuffer` call.
- `extensions/tlon/src/monitor/media.ts`, `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.ts`: `TLON_MEDIA_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS` / `TLON_UPLOAD_IMAGE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15 * 60_000`, passed into the shared fetch options; existing null / original-URL fallback paths unchanged.

**Tests (focused suite, run locally via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`; Crabbox unavailable in this environment so the allowed local fallback was used):**
- `extensions/tlon/src/monitor/media.test.ts` / `upload.test.ts`: switched the two exact-match `toHaveBeenCalledWith` assertions to `expect.objectContaining(...)` and assert `timeoutMs: 15 * 60_000`; retained the `returns null` / `returns original URL` fallback coverage.
- `src/media/web-media.test.ts`: added `aborts a stalled remote fetch via the overall timeoutMs deadline` — a controlled stalled-endpoint test where the fetch accepts the connection but never returns headers; the guarded-fetch abort signal fires at the `timeoutMs` deadline and `loadWebMediaRaw` rejects.

**Proof transcript (redacted):**
```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/tlon/src/monitor/media.test.ts extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts
 ✓ extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts > uploadImageFromUrl > fetches image and calls uploadFile, returns uploaded URL
 ✓ extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts > uploadImageFromUrl > returns original URL if fetch fails
 ✓ extensions/tlon/src/urbit/upload.test.ts > uploadImageFromUrl > returns original URL when the remote image exceeds the image cap
 ✓ extensions/tlon/src/monitor/media.test.ts > tlon monitor media > stores fetched media through the shared inbound media store with the image cap
 ✓ extensions/tlon/src/monitor/media.test.ts > tlon monitor media > returns null when the fetch exceeds the image cap
 Test Files  2 passed (2) | Tests 11 passed (11)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/media/web-media.test.ts
 ✓ src/media/web-media.test.ts > loadWebMedia > applies the shared remote read idle timeout for raw web media loads
 ✓ src/media/web-media.test.ts > loadWebMedia > aborts a stalled remote fetch via the overall timeoutMs deadline
 ✓ src/media/web-media.test.ts > loadWebMedia > loads a valid remote PDF when the raw web media read stays active
 Test Files 1 passed (1) | Tests 76 passed (76)
```

Change: +80 / -14 across 6 files (3 source, 3 tests).
